app.name: Elha2
app.demoBanner: Demo build: sign-in, storage, notifications and AI are simulated. No real services are connected.

signIn.title: Sign in to the Elha2 portal
signIn.subtitle: Use your Egyptian mobile number. We send a one-time code by SMS.
signIn.codeHint: Demo code: 654321. The code expires after 5 minutes.

errors.invalidPhone: Enter an Egyptian mobile number that starts with 010, 011, 012 or 015.
errors.wrongCode: That code is not right. Check the SMS and try again.
errors.locked: Too many wrong codes. You can try again at {{time}}.
errors.reasonRequired: Write a reason so the organisation knows what to fix.
errors.invalidTransition: This organisation has already been decided.
errors.rateLimited: Please wait a minute before asking for another code.
errors.unavailable: We couldn't reach the sign-in service. Check your connection and try again.
errors.notAdmin: This number is not an Elha2 administrator. Choose your organisation role instead.

business.pending: An administrator is reviewing your documents. You can list surplus once you are verified.
business.verified: You are verified. Your branches can list surplus food.
business.rejected: Your registration was rejected. Read the reason, fix it and register again.
business.infoRequested: The administrator needs more information. Read the request below.

ngo.pending: An administrator is reviewing your registration. Donation offers start once you are verified.
ngo.verified: You are verified and can receive donation offers.
ngo.rejected: Your registration was rejected. Read the reason, fix it and register again.
ngo.infoRequested: The administrator needs more information. Read the request below.
